findings.issue: Commit 015016c13 (a11y fixes, 21:01Z) changed web source after web typecheck (20:47Z), lint (20:48Z), next build (20:56Z) and the full web test run (20:46Z). The logs do not show those gates passing on the final web source. The coverage and diff-coverage rows ran later but do not substitute for typecheck, lint or build.
findings.fix: Rerun pnpm --filter @intelliflow/web typecheck, lint, next build and the web test row on HEAD 053c6874c, then refresh rows 08-11 in summary.tsv.

findings.issue: Row 18 records exit 1 (first failed attempt) while 18-diff-coverage.log is the rerun with exit 0. The log header names HEAD 1cd895b72 plus uncommitted changes, not the current HEAD.
findings.fix: Update row 18 to the rerun's exit and timestamps, and rerun against the committed HEAD so the header matches.

findings.file: tests/integration/availability.test.ts; apps/api unit tests for appointment-settings and appointments router; other new test files
findings.issue: Added test code uses 'any' (prisma: any, client: any, 'as any' on mocks) and the integration test calls console.log. Not production code, but the Foundation rule is no any or console.log added in the diff.
findings.fix: Type the mocks, or confirm test files are exempt from the no-any rule; replace console.log in the integration test with the repo's skip helper if one exists.

findings.issue: Raw diff shows 1874/1837, 6047/5964 and 1106/1076 lines added/removed. Ignoring whitespace and line endings the real change is 58/21, 89/6 and 30/0. The inflated diff hides the real change from review.
findings.fix: Restore the original line endings for these three files so the diff shows only the real edits.

findings.issue: Three waiver entries for one finding, all authored 'pending owner confirmation'. The waiver is self-authored by the lane, not owner-approved.
findings.fix: Collapse to one entry if the fingerprint is stable, and get the owner's confirmation (the lane already lists it as NEEDS_HUMAN).

findings.issue: Uncommitted modification in the worktree, unrelated to PG-202.
findings.fix: Keep it out of the PR.

limitations: Read-only review: no tests, builds, typecheck or lint were run, as instructed. Exit codes come from summary.tsv and the tails of the 09, 10, 11, 18 and 19 logs plus codex-review-6.log; per-row test counts for rows 01-08 and 12-17 were not read. The forbidden-construct grep covered added lines in the origin/main...HEAD diff only. The gh #913 reference and debt-ledger id cited by the waiver were not verified. matop/knip.log, sql-review.json, migration-freeze.txt and design-check-availability.md were not opened (other STOAs own those).
